name: INSC NFT
rootCause: There is a vulnerability in the INSC NFT contract, and multiple hackers have exploited it to steal NFTs and transfer them to Blur and OpenSea for sale. According to Blur market data, the floor price of INSC (ins-20) has dropped to 0.0048 ETH, with a decrease of 96.76% in the last 24 hours.
